_evidence: 0x00414439 reads the target pointer dword +0x128 (or ebx,ebx; je: null takes the stc exit, so it is nullable), and when set subtracts the car position dwords [esi]/[esi+4] from the target's [ebx]/[ebx+4], feeding 0x401315 (atan2 by div) and the 64-bit sum of squares to 0x40113f (sqrt). Positions are coordinates of the i16 record frame << 11 (-0x4000000..0x3fff7ff, pos_00405cf8 for the target), so the differences stay below 2^27: a difference of exactly 0x80000000 would make 0x401315's neg overflow and its div #DE in the original, which game positions never produce.
